purpose: Evaluate frozen V3 DeepONet on newly specified observation-count and tenor interventions. No training or model selection.
families: All 256 V3 test families plus all six publicly reconciled monthly stress contracts; prior tests already inspected, so this is an extension of the diagnostic benchmark, not a newly untouched final test.

nobs.intervals: early: inception to first redemption observation; middle: gap ending at index nobs//2 (0-based); late: penultimate to final observation
nobs.date: Midpoint of the chosen interval, nearest integer calendar day; monthly contracts use following Korean bank day. Existing dates unchanged.
nobs.strike: First strike for early insertion; otherwise linear interpolation of adjacent strikes at the inserted date.
nobs.cashflows: Regular coupon accrual interpolated between adjacent accrual factors (inception factor zero). No new Lizard clause. All existing redemption and monthly coupon terms unchanged; monthly contract adds no new coupon date.
nobs.capacity: Only baseline nobs<=11 is representable by existing ContractV3 and frozen model; baseline nobs=12 recorded as unsupported, never truncated.

tenor.regular: New final observation day = old day + round(months*365/12). Scale every observation day and coupon accrual factor by new/old horizon, retaining annual coupon, strikes, barriers, count and each original calendar payment lag. Lizard premium scales by the same factor to preserve its baseline annualized rate.
tenor.monthly: New final observation = old final calendar date shifted by integer months, then following Korean bank day. Scale redemption observation offsets, adjust new observations to bank days, retain count/strikes/barriers and issuer business-day payment lag. Regular and survival accruals remain zero; Lizard premium scaled by horizon ratio.
tenor.monthly_shortening: Keep original coupon observations/payments through new final observation. If maturity lies before a scheduled next coupon and after the prior coupon, add a final prorated stub using elapsed-days/original-period-days times that next coupon accrual and its barrier. No inferred coupon if no future original entitlement exists.
tenor.monthly_extension: Keep all original coupons unchanged. Starting at the old final observation, append calendar-month anniversaries, adjusted following bank day, through the new final observation. Added installments use the original last coupon barrier and accrual; annual coupon unchanged. This does not fill a missing original maturity coupon retroactively.
tenor.meaning: One contractual intervention with its dependent schedule/cash-flow changes, not a claim that tenor and every payment date can vary independently. Rules are explicitly defined synthetic contracts, not newly confirmed issuer terms.

market: Same V3 inception-only 3-asset daily-calendar-grid GBM, constant vol/correlation, q=0, same KRW NS curve across each family; each contract monitors KI only through its own maturity.

mc.seed_rule: first 8 SHA256 hex digits of family:replicate:MCscheduleV4

coupling: One common simulated daily path to the longest maturity per family; union of all observation dates; shorter contracts consume the same path prefix. Paired payoff-difference variance, not independent price-SE addition.

models.selection: Inherited V3 validation selection; all nine existing checkpoints frozen, no retraining/seed picking/selection from this experiment.

diagnostics: 3 MC seeds and 3 training seeds separately
tolerance_note: 1/5/10 KRW diagnostics, not business-approved acceptance criteria. No sign is forced for observation-count or tenor changes.
preservation: Original engines, labels, families and all model checkpoints unchanged. New code and outputs in this directory; Report_2 receives a separately dated addendum.
